text:
Maya (PMM): quick sync 10 10 we need a battlecard + inbound routing rules for the upcoming webinar/benchmark post. focus: three competitor buckets (cloud infra, hosted APIs, infra vendors). keep it paste-ready for AE/SE.
Diego - Field: field needs 100 line threat + 100 line rebuttal per bucket. also a 15s demo pitch for the webinar host.
Priya - GTM: routing: simple thresholds only. projected_monthly_spend > $2.5k -> AE; mentions [on-prem,VPC,SLA] -> AE+security; trial_tpm>5k -> SE loop-in. map region by IP.
Zoe - Content: I'll do a one-pager: left column competitor claim, right column 2000 word rebuttal + proofline. plus 3 AE paste-snippets and a 15s host soundbite.
benchmarks-bot: PUBLIC GUIDANCE: avoid absolute multiples in public. publish indexed charts and "typical improvement band". raw numbers go into internal appendix. include brief methodology note.
routing-bot: :white_check_mark: rules created: spend>2500 -> tag:ae; keywords [on-prem,VPC,SLA] -> tag:security+ae; tpm>5000 -> tag:se
Priya - GTM: sample webhook for eng/SFDC: email=acct@org.com; proj_spend_usd=4300; flags=["VPC","embeddings"]; route=ae-us-east. keep it minimal.
Diego - Field: demo pitch (15s): "We stabilize latency under load and cut effective token spend — same API across hosted, dedicated, private. We'll show a live routing demo."
Maya (PMM): assign: Zoe -> battlecard copy + host soundbite; Priya -> SFDC mapping & routing test; Diego -> AE/SE paste-snippets; benchmarks-bot -> appendix note. I'll assemble v0 and share by tomorrow 10am.
Zoe - Content: will drop first draft tonight.
Maya (PMM): perfect. keep language defensible and engineer-friendly. :rocket:
